articles.title: Teenager’s TikTok video prompted U.S. warning of possible Moscow terrorist attack, Russia’s FSB says
articles.description: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said a teenager who posted a video on TikTok was the source of information about a planned terrorist attack in Moscow, a threat the U.S. Embassy had warned about the day before.

articles.title: Russia detains teen following U.S. tip about possible terrorist attack
articles.description: Russian authorities announced the detention of a teenager following a tip from U.S. law enforcement concerning a threat targeting a Moscow museum.

articles.description: A demonstration outside the US Embassy in London against the UK government's ban on Palestine Action leads to over 300 arrests. Participants rallied for freedom of expression amid claims of repression surrounding the proscription of the group.

articles.title: US Embassy Issues Security Alert Over Houthi Attacks in Saudi Arabia
articles.description: The US Embassy has issued a security alert for Americans in Saudi Arabia due to potential Houthi attacks on airports and critical infrastructure. Non-emergency staff have been ordered to leave as hostilities in the region continue to escalate.
